description: Append-only, evidence-backed adjudications of FRAME-versus-DERA contradictions (ADR-085). Consumed by the dera-validate mode: an exactly-matching contradiction is reclassified into a non-gating adjudicated category and recorded, with this file's SHA-256, in the validation manifest samples. Only replaced-submission events with concrete replacement/backdating evidence may be recorded here (ADR-085 decisions C and D); events without such evidence remain gating and unresolved. Two known unresolved events are deliberately NOT recorded: Vodafone (0000839923, 0001104659-22-116238), a deleted late-filed FY2018 20-F with no replacement accession, and CASI Pharmaceuticals (0000895051, 0001558370-23-006754), a 20-F filed after the entity's Form 15-12G deregistration of 2023-03-22 with succession under a different CIK. DERA remains an independent FRAME validation source only.
